SELECT 'sales' t, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) d, min(sale_date) mn, max(sale_date) mx, sum(CASE WHEN staff_purchase_flag THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) staff, sum(CASE WHEN channel_code='WB' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) web, sum(CASE WHEN quantity<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nonpos FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-26' AND DATE '2025-06-22'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'returns_all', count(*), count(DISTINCT return_line_id), min(return_date), max(return_date), count(DISTINCT sales_line_id), 0, sum(CASE WHEN quantity_returned<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM fact_return_line
UNION ALL
SELECT 'returns_for_P2_sales', count(*), count(DISTINCT r.return_line_id), min(return_date), max(return_date), count(DISTINCT r.sales_line_id), 0, sum(CASE WHEN r.quantity_returned<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM fact_return_line r JOIN fact_sales_line s USING (sales_line_id) WHERE s.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-26' AND DATE '2025-06-22'

WITH s AS (
  SELECT f.*, st.store_id, st.format, st.store_name FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key=f.store_key
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-26' AND DATE '2025-06-22'
)
SELECT 'dupe receipt/line' chk, count(*) - count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) v FROM s
UNION ALL SELECT 'sales rows with neg net', count(*) FROM s WHERE net_amount<=0
UNION ALL SELECT 'sales rows format not store', count(*) FROM s WHERE store_id>=900
UNION ALL SELECT 'staff rows', count(*) FROM s WHERE staff_purchase_flag
UNION ALL SELECT 'sales in stg also in fact', count(*) FROM stg_sales_line_load g WHERE g.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-26' AND DATE '2025-06-22'
UNION ALL SELECT 'channel mismatch (ST at 900 / WB not 900)', count(*) FROM s WHERE (channel_code='WB') <> (store_id=900)
UNION ALL SELECT 'returns qty > sold qty', count(*) FROM (SELECT r.sales_line_id, sum(r.quantity_returned) q, any_value(s.quantity) sq FROM fact_return_line r JOIN s ON s.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id GROUP BY 1) WHERE q>sq
UNION ALL SELECT 'multiple returns per line', count(*) FROM (SELECT sales_line_id FROM fact_return_line GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>1)
UNION ALL SELECT 'return before sale', count(*) FROM fact_return_line r JOIN s ON s.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id WHERE r.return_date < s.sale_date
UNION ALL SELECT 'refund_net > net', count(*) FROM fact_return_line r JOIN s ON s.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id WHERE r.refund_net > s.net_amount
UNION ALL SELECT 'return store != sale store', count(*) FROM fact_return_line r JOIN s ON s.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id WHERE r.store_key <> s.store_key
UNION ALL SELECT 'return rows in stg_return too', count(*) FROM fact_return_line r JOIN stg_return_line_load g USING (return_line_id)
UNION ALL SELECT 'orphan returns (no sale line)', count(*) FROM fact_return_line r WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fact_sales_line f WHERE f.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id)
UNION ALL SELECT 'etl_loaded_at distinct dates in P2', count(DISTINCT CAST(etl_loaded_at AS DATE)) FROM s

WITH s AS (
  SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.quantity, f.net_amount, f.gross_amount, f.staff_purchase_flag, st.store_id, st.format
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key=f.store_key
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-26' AND DATE '2025-06-22'
), j AS (
  SELECT s.*, coalesce(r.refund_net,0) refund_net, coalesce(r.refund_gross,0) refund_gross, coalesce(r.quantity_returned,0) qty_ret
  FROM s LEFT JOIN fact_return_line r ON r.sales_line_id=s.sales_line_id
)
SELECT format, staff_purchase_flag staff, count(*) lines, count(DISTINCT store_id) stores, sum(quantity) units, sum(net_amount) net_sold, sum(refund_net) refunded_net, sum(qty_ret) units_ret,
 round(100*sum(refund_net)/sum(net_amount),3) val_rate, round(100*sum(qty_ret)/sum(quantity),3) unit_rate, round(100*sum(refund_gross)/sum(gross_amount),3) gross_rate, round(100.0*count(*) FILTER (WHERE qty_ret>0)/count(*),3) line_rate
FROM j GROUP BY ROLLUP(format, staff_purchase_flag) ORDER BY 1,2

WITH s AS (
  SELECT f.net_amount, f.staff_purchase_flag, st.store_id FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key=f.store_key
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-26' AND DATE '2025-06-22' AND st.store_id<900
)
SELECT 'fact all stores' k, sum(net_amount) v FROM s
UNION ALL SELECT 'fact ex staff', sum(net_amount) FROM s WHERE NOT staff_purchase_flag
UNION ALL SELECT 'rpt before returns', sum(net_sales_before_returns) FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-26' AND DATE '2025-06-22' AND store_id<900
UNION ALL SELECT 'rpt before returns incl 900+', sum(net_sales_before_returns) FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-26' AND DATE '2025-06-22'
UNION ALL SELECT 'rpt max store_id', max(store_id) FROM rpt_daily_store_sales
UNION ALL SELECT 'reason ' || coalesce(reason_code,'NULL'), sum(refund_net) FROM fact_return_line r JOIN fact_sales_line f USING (sales_line_id) WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-26' AND DATE '2025-06-22' GROUP BY reason_code

SELECT count(*) lines_with_version_outside_validity, count(DISTINCT st.store_id) stores
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key=f.store_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-26' AND DATE '2025-06-22' AND NOT (f.sale_date BETWEEN st.valid_from AND st.valid_to)

SELECT st.format AS store_format,
       round(100 * sum(coalesce(r.refund_net, 0)) / sum(f.net_amount), 2) AS return_rate_pct
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key = f.store_key
LEFT JOIN fact_return_line r ON r.sales_line_id = f.sales_line_id
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-26' AND DATE '2025-06-22'
  AND st.store_id < 900
GROUP BY st.format
ORDER BY st.format
